verdict.rationale: The docs show Claude Code automatically recalls persistent project context: CLAUDE.md is read at the start of every session and holds standards, architecture decisions, and preferred libraries. However, the evidence describes CLAUDE.md as a file the developer adds and maintains, and a community user reports manually adding more and more CLAUDE.md guide rails. That means the automatic memory-building half of the story is not evidenced. missing for 10: evidence the agent automatically writes or updates its own memory across sessions, documentation of an auto-memory mechanism, independent hands-on corroboration of automatic cross-session recall.
